description: This file defines Express routes for managing user bookmarks, including fetching, adding, and deleting bookmarks. It relies on User model and authentication middleware.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Fetches all bookmarks for the authenticated user.

methods.name: POST /
methods.description: Adds a new bookmark for the authenticated user, ensuring idempotency by URL.

methods.name: DELETE /
methods.description: Removes a bookmark identified by URL for the authenticated user.
